0.original: Runar has more work to be done.

28.original: Show the jade heartstone to Minfilia.

29.original: Deliver the jade heartstone to Runar.

49.original: Done tending to the crops already?

50.original: Very good. It should not be long before your room is ready.

52.original: In the woods... <pant> <pant> Sin eaters. I fear they may have the touch.

54.original: In the grove to the southwest. For a mercy, they've yet to wander any closer to Slitherbough.

55.original: Then we have no need to engage. Inform the guard that no one is to set foot outside the village until they have moved on.

56.original: But sir, what of Toddia's heartstone?

57.original: It must be retrieved before the service.

58.original: Of all the times for sin eaters to appear...

59.original: Are you just going to leave them alone?

60.original: Under normal circumstances, we would not hesitate in striking the beasts down. But if they indeed have the touch, I will not risk them corrupting one of our own.

61.original: What was that you said about a stone?

62.original: A few days past, Toddia, a child of the Night's Blessed, was slain by the sin eaters.

63.original: We succeeded in retrieving her body, but in our haste, we failed to notice her necklace was gone.

64.original: Strung to it was a pendant of jade─her heartstone. All of the Night's Blessed are given such a stone at birth. It is the most valuable possession one can own.

65.original: It is custom to present the heartstone of the deceased at their funeral, as an offering to the heavens. But now...

66.original: What if... What if I could find it for you?

67.original: I have experience fighting sin eaters. And the Light's...corruption does not touch me like it does others.

68.original: Master Matoya called you Minfilia, did she not? Are you truly <hex:021A020203>the<hex:021A020103> Minfilia? Descended from the Oracle?

69.original: Even so, I dare not ask you to risk your life for the Blessed.

70.original: I understand how you feel, but I can't stand by knowing that your people are in need and I can help. Please, let me do this.

71.original: Very well. But if the danger proves too great, you must retreat. I could never forgive myself if we were forced to hold a second service.

72.original: <gasp> I nearly forgot about Thancred. What if he returns before I do?

74.original: Don't worry. I'll come with you.

76.original: Thank you. With you at my side, I'm certain we can deal with them in no time at all.

77.original: Wh-What!? Do you mean to say...you'll come with me?

78.original: Thank you. Let's hurry then, before he returns.

79.original: Go swiftly, and may the shadows keep you both.

80.original: Do not be reckless. We would be glad to have her heartstone returned to us, but it is not worth both of your lives.

81.original: Please, I beg of you. We must have that gem.

82.original: It should be around here somewhere, I think.

84.original: I was hoping there would only be one...

85.original: There's no way we can search for the stone without dealing with them first.

88.original: Perhaps we should split them up.

89.original: What do you propose we do?

90.original: What? Shouldn't we make a plan first?

92.original: I'll draw one of them away. You can deal with the other.

93.original: Good idea. I'll draw one away while you handle the other.

94.original: Fighting them together here would make a lot of noise, which might attract beasts or other eaters...

95.original: But if we fought them separately and quietly, we might not have to worry about that.

96.original: All right, then. I'll draw one away while you handle the other.

98.original: It's done. Though, I fear I was a bit careless. I'll do better next time, I promise.

99.original: I... I'm fine. You needn't worry about me. More importantly, we have to find that heartstone.

100.original: They said it was made of jade, right? I'll search over there in the brush.

102.original: There seems to be no trace of the heartstone here.

103.original: You brush away the leaves and uncover a brilliant green gem.

105.original: It's beautiful! This has to be it.

106.original: ...You know, Thancred always said you were a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> of many talents, and I think I'm beginning to understand what he meant.

107.original: I have much to learn if I'm to be even half the hero you are.

109.original: Ah, I'm sorry. Forget I said anything.

110.original: We should hurry back to Slitherbough. Runar and the others are probably worried.

113.original: Thank goodness you are safe. I had begun to fear the worst.

114.original: By all that is dark, you found it!

115.original: We can proceed with her service as planned.

116.original: These blessed gems serve not only to protect us in life, but to guide our spirits unto the sunless sea in the hereafter.

117.original: Even should we be felled by the sin eaters, so long as these gems are recovered, our souls are ensured peace in the dark.
